resources.string: Download an HTTPS link to a supported media file, PDF, or archive. No website resolution, HLS/DASH, format selection, login, or manual pause. Servers must allow a HEAD check and provide a matching file type.

Saved in this app’s external Downloads folder, not public Downloads. Files are removed when the app is uninstalled. Android manages transfers, including on mobile data. AutoGram stores only download IDs and filenames; Android retains the source URL to perform the download.
Up to %1$d active downloads and %2$d saved records. Remove finished records to make room.
Stop %1$s and remove its partial file? You will need to submit the link again to restart. If Android has already reported completion, the file will be kept.
Removing a record keeps its file. This screen cannot restore a removed record.
Download failed. Submit a fresh direct link to retry.
Download record is no longer available in Android.
The downloaded response has an unsupported or unknown file type. Opening is disabled.
Use a complete HTTPS direct-file URL with a supported extension. Watch pages, manifests, credentials, fragments, and extensionless links are not supported.
Could not verify this link. Check your connection and use a fresh link whose server supports HEAD requests.
The server redirected the check. Use the final direct HTTPS file URL.
The server returned HTML, a manifest, an unknown type, or a type that does not match the file extension.
The app’s external Downloads folder is unavailable or not writable.
Android Download Manager is unavailable. Check that it is enabled on this device.
Android could not start this download. Check available storage and Download Manager.
Could not save the download record. Check device storage and try again.
Could not refresh Android download status. Status will be checked again while this screen is active.
Could not cancel this download. Refreshing its Android status.
Could not open this file. It may have been removed, or no compatible app is installed.
Download limit reached. Wait for active downloads or remove finished records from the list.
